d: India has delivered one of its strongest messages of support for Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks intensify across the Kingdom. New Delhi has strongly condemned the November 24 attack on a tower in Riyadh's financial district, which injured 11 people, including two Indian nationals. India has called for an immediate cessation of attacks targeting Saudi Arabia's civilian, economic and energy infrastructure, reaffirming its unwavering support for the Kingdom's sovereignty and security.
